name: Stable Audio
summary: Stability AI's audio toolkit for generating music and sound with commercially safe models.
description: Stable Audio is Stability AI's tool for creating music and sound effects with models trained for commercial safety, aimed at iterative creative work by professionals. The Free plan gives 50 credits per month for personal, non-commercial use. Solo costs $12 per month with a commercial licence, Session $30, Producer $90 and Studio $199 per month. An enterprise option exists for larger organisations.
